name: Validate exercise spec
description: On saving an exercise definition JSON, run schema + semantic validation and the fixture replay.

action.prompt: An exercise spec JSON was saved. Validate it against .kiro/steering/exercise-spec-authoring.md and spec 02 (exercise-spec-engine): every landmark used in an expression is in requiredLandmarks; every phase named in a transition/fault exists in phases.states; exactly one transition emits RepCompleted for mode 'reps'; the phase graph is strongly connected from initial; every cue is <= 4 words and passes the banned-word list in coaching-safety.md; hysteresisPct >= 0.05 and minPhaseDurationMs >= 250; a fixture exists for the spec id. If the CLI exists, run `npx formcoach-spec validate <file>` and `npx formcoach-spec replay <file> --fixture <id>`. Report any failure with the exact constraint violated and the path.
